summary: Iteration 2 frontend testing focused on new editability features: marquee, price suffix, CEP-based map update, footer headings/legal, navbar in Admin, and localizacao button texts. All 12 specified features verified and passing.

issues: Footer headings (Links rápidos, Endereço, Contato) are rendered via CSS `uppercase` class which transforms them visually. The config values are lowercase ('Links rápidos') but appear as 'LINKS RÁPIDOS'. This is expected behavior per the design, not a bug.

feature_test_results.marquee_words_from_config: PASS - All 5 words (SEM ENTRADA, 100% DIGITAL, TUDO INCLUSO, TROCA FLEXÍVEL, COBERTURA 24H) from defaultConfig render in marquee
feature_test_results.hero_price_period: PASS - Hero overlay shows 'A PARTIR DE' and 'R$ X/mês' using config.global.priceFromLabel and config.global.pricePeriod
feature_test_results.frota_cards_price_period: PASS - Each bike card shows 'R$ X/mês' using config.global.pricePeriod
feature_test_results.admin_panel_opens: PASS - Gear button (data-testid=admin-gear-btn) opens the Sheet panel correctly
feature_test_results.admin_conteudo_navbar: PASS - NAVBAR section has CTA (desktop)='Assinar', CTA (mobile)='Assinar agora', and 4 link fields
feature_test_results.admin_conteudo_marquee: PASS - FAIXA ANIMADA section has Separador field, 5 word fields each with remove button, + Adicionar button works (6→5 on remove)
feature_test_results.admin_conteudo_precos: PASS - PREÇOS section has 'Sufixo de período' (value='mês') and 'Rótulo a partir de' (value='a partir de')
feature_test_results.admin_contato_cep_map_update: PASS - Typing in CEP/address field immediately updates the map embed URL (e.g. 'Rua Oscar Freire' → maps?q=Rua%20Oscar%20Freire...)
feature_test_results.admin_contato_button_texts: PASS - 'Texto do botão "Como chegar"' and 'Texto do botão "WhatsApp"' fields present and populated
feature_test_results.admin_contato_footer_headings: PASS - Fields for 'Título coluna Links rápidos', 'Título coluna Endereço', 'Título coluna Contato', 'Texto: Política de Privacidade', 'Texto: Termos de Uso' all present
feature_test_results.footer_headings_from_config: PASS - Footer renders headings from config.footer.headings (visible as LINKS RÁPIDOS, ENDEREÇO, CONTATO via CSS uppercase)
feature_test_results.localizacao_buttons_from_config: PASS - 'Como chegar' and 'Falar no WhatsApp' buttons render from config.localizacao.comoChegar and .falarWhats

action_items: From iteration 1 (still pending): Fix bg-accent-nb transparent background issue caused by incompatible CSS variable channel format in hexToRgb / tailwind.config.js.
From iteration 1 (still pending): App/section components hardcode bg colors so --nb-bg body change has no visible effect on page theme.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPanel.jsx is 635 lines — approaching the 700-line limit; consider splitting into sub-components (MarqueeAdmin, PricesAdmin, ContactAdmin) for maintainability.

CEP onChange in AdminPanel sets mapEmbed with encodeURIComponent which generates %20-style encoding while the original default config uses + (plus) style. Both work for Google Maps but are inconsistent — minor cosmetic issue.
Saved config from previous sessions has non-default values (price 369.99, video URL, counter 1537). This is expected persistence behavior, not a bug.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Admin Panel was used to test CEP field and marquee add/remove, but changes were NOT saved (no 'Salvar' click).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 new editability features (marquee, price suffix, CEP map update, footer headings/legal, navbar admin, localizacao button texts) are working correctly. Remaining open items from iteration 1: accent color bg-accent-nb transparent issue and body background theming. Current live config has non-default values (price 369.99, video, counter 1537) from previous manual edits — normal persistence.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found in this iteration. All features implemented correctly per code review of EditorialMarquee.jsx, Hero.jsx, Frota.jsx, Footer.jsx, Localizacao.jsx, and AdminPanel.jsx.
